description: This file contains the implementation of AggregateHashMap, a class used in Apache Spark for fast key-value lookups with a focus on single-key, single-value long-type pairs, utilizing linear probing hash map techniques.

classes.name: AggregateHashMap
classes.description: A hash map implementation optimized for single-key, single-value long pairs, supporting fast lookups and insertions with linear probing.

methods.name: findOrInsert
methods.description: Finds the bucket index for a given key or inserts it if not present, updating internal vectors and buckets accordingly.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Locates the index of a key within the hash map using linear probing, returning -1 if not found.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Computes a hash value for a given long key (identity function in this implementation).

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if the key at a given index matches a provided key.
